name: portico-row
title: Portico Row
description: Cool-white institutional gravitas for firms whose only product is credibility. Brand navy is structure (header bands, engraved hairline rules, serif wordmark) and never decorates content panels; Source Serif 4 display over a 19px Source Sans 3 body floor; square 0-2px corners with hairlines instead of shadows; airy 72-120px bands; numbered substance rows with figure and date; attorney cards with credential lines; a mandatory compliance footer on every page.
author: uiforagents

ramp.body: 19px / 400 / 1.6 (the floor: body text never ships below 19px)

notes: One-shot PASS 2026-10-12, attorney profile page (the spec's named practice-area detail type is a documented prompt-pack recipe, so per the group one-shot rule the nearest undocumented page type was used; recorded here). Navy is structural only: bands, rules, wordmark; it never fills or decorates content panels. Serif is display sizes and pull quotes only; body is always sans at the 19px floor. Engraved hairlines (all >= 3:1) replace every shadow. Wash tints never sit under body text. One primary CTA per page; every page carries a numbered substance row and the compliance footer. Brass hairlines are optional flavor, never structural. One-shot re-run 2026-10-26: PASS - fresh agent given only prompt-pack + theme + overrides built a practice areas overview page (single-file build), identity-faithful; headless check clean: zero console errors, no document overflow at 1280/390/360.
